description.value: Fatburger & Buffalo's Express in Courtenay is a casual fast-food burger restaurant offering cooked-to-order burgers made with fresh, never-frozen Alberta Angus beef, alongside chicken tenders and wings, veggie burgers, and hand-scooped real ice cream milkshakes. Part of the Canadian-owned Fatburger chain with roots going back to 1952, this Courtenay location also carries the Buffalo's Express chicken menu. Takeout and online ordering are available, making it a potential quick refueling stop for cyclists passing through the Ryan Road corridor.
